cohort: The study included 547 stillbirths and 709 neonatal deaths that occurred at Ghaem Hospital of Mashhad, Iran.
finding: Maternal hypertension, preeclampsia, and diabetes were identified as important diseases during pregnancy associated with a higher incidence of stillbirths and neonatal deaths.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean delivery was higher in neonates of mothers with identified risk factors compared to those without maternal problems.
birth_weight: Measured; neonates of mothers with problems were observed to have lower birth weight.
gest_age: Measured; neonates of mothers with problems were observed to be pretermer.
